And if not, maybe we can just send everything to my place in the city instead?

If you can pull up my recent order with both office and hiking stuff, that should be the one. Sorry for being a bit vague—my memory’s still on vacation!

Let’s go with option one—please remove the office items (keyboard, headphones, and chair) and just send me the hiking gear. I’ll save the office chair races for another day! Can you also let me know how much I’ll get back for the stuff you’re removing, and make sure the refund goes to my original payment method?

That sounds perfect—please go ahead and remove the office items and send the refund to my PayPal. I’ll stick to hiking and leave the office chair Olympics for another time! Thanks for helping me out with this.
Yes, that’s exactly what I want—just the Cycling Helmet and Hiking Boots, and the refund for the office stuff sent to my PayPal. Go ahead and make it official!

Alright, since my brain can barely handle another plot twist, let’s just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead. That way, I’ll get everything and can figure out what to do with the office stuff later. What do you need from me to update the address?
Yep, that’s the one—224 Elm Street, Suite 491, New York, NY 10108. Please send my order there, and I’ll wrestle with the office chair when it arrives. Thanks for sorting this out!
Thanks a lot! I appreciate your help—hopefully my hiking boots get more use than my swivel chair. Have a great day! ###STOP###
